settings.value: Example Firm Consumer Bankruptcy & Debt Relief Attorneys PLLC (overlong name)
settings.label: Firm name
settings.description: The firm's legal / display name on generated documents (e-sign contracts, retainers). Blank falls back to a hardcoded name rather than rendering an empty one.

settings.label: Firm logo URL
settings.description: Logo shown in the app and on client-facing pages and emails. Blank falls back to the FIRM_LOGO env var.

settings.label: Firm phone
settings.description: Main firm phone. Canonical format is 10 digits, no punctuation; display formatting happens at render.

settings.label: Firm website
settings.description: Public firm website URL.

settings.label: Firm email
settings.description: Public-facing office email, used in client-facing templates and pages.

settings.label: Firm mailing address
settings.description: One JSON string per line, e.g. ["123 Main St., #100","City, ST 00000"]. Used on generated documents (firm.address_line1 / firm.address_line2, or firm.address inline). Blank = no address renders; a template that requires it refuses to send.

settings.label: Signing attorney name
settings.description: The attorney named on generated documents, and stripped from signer lists when identifying the client. Blank falls back to a hardcoded name.

settings.label: Automations email
settings.description: From-address used by automated emails.

settings.label: Default email from
settings.description: Default sender when a send names none.

settings.label: Firm email domains
settings.description: Comma-separated. An email FROM one of these domains is classified as outgoing by the ingest pipeline. Include the @.

settings.label: Default SMS from
settings.description: Line used for client texts when a send names none.

settings.label: Staff SMS from
settings.description: Line used for staff alert texts.

settings.label: IT email
settings.description: Destination for system / IT notifications.

settings.label: Default email to
settings.description: The firm catch-all inbox: recipient when nothing more specific is set (e.g. the event digest).

settings.label: Alert recipients
settings.description: Comma-separated emails that receive system alerts.

settings.label: Alert from email
settings.description: Sender address of system alert emails.

settings.label: Critical alert SMS to
settings.description: Phone that receives a text for critical alerts.

settings.label: Office alerts to
settings.description: Staff who receive office alert texts and e-sign / upload follow-up tasks (the first usable user is the assignee).

settings.label: Billing tasks to
settings.description: Staff member who receives payment-failure and late-fee tasks.

settings.label: Default task assignee
settings.description: Gets appointment follow-up tasks (cancel / reschedule-later) when no staff member did the action, e.g. a client cancellation. Unset or not a user: no task is created and an alert is raised.

settings.label: Event digest recipients
settings.description: Staff who receive the upcoming-events digest. Blank = the default email to, then the firm email.

settings.label: Manage cutoff (min)
settings.description: Clients cannot cancel or reschedule within this many minutes of the appointment.

settings.label: Manage horizon (days)
settings.description: How far ahead clients can rebook.

settings.value: Your appointment has been canceled. Need a new time? https://example-firm.test/book/consult
settings.label: Cancel SMS template
settings.description: Text sent to a client who cancels from their manage link.

settings.value: Your appointment is set for {{appts.appt_date|date:dddd MMMM Do}} at {{appts.appt_date|time:h:mm A}}. Manage or cancel anytime: https://example-firm.test/m/{{appts.appt_manage_token|default:}}
settings.label: Reschedule SMS template
settings.description: Text sent after a client reschedules. Placeholders resolve against the appointment.

settings.label: Manage fallback link
settings.description: {"url": "...", "button_text": "..."} shown when a manage link has expired.

settings.label: Client self-cancel
settings.description: Clients may cancel a scheduled appointment from their manage link (1 = yes, 0 = call the office). The cutoff still applies.

settings.label: Client self-reschedule
settings.description: Clients may reschedule a scheduled appointment from their manage link. Cutoff and horizon still apply.

settings.label: Client rebook after cancel
settings.description: A canceled appointment's manage page offers "pick a new time". Keep it equal to self-reschedule: rebook on with reschedule off lets clients reschedule by canceling first.

settings.label: Shabbos lead (min)
settings.description: Minutes before sunset that availability closes on Friday.

settings.label: Shabbos end (min)
settings.description: Minutes after sunset that availability reopens on Saturday night.

settings.label: Folder templates
settings.description: Folder-name templates per case stage. Leading / trailing spaces inside values are load-bearing (manual sort order) and are preserved verbatim.

settings.value: /  Law Office/   Cases/  Unsorted Client Uploads
settings.label: Unsorted client uploads folder
settings.description: Where client uploads land when the case has no working folder and one cannot be created (a per-case subfolder). Leading spaces are load-bearing.

settings.value: /  Law Office/   Cases/  Unsorted Form Submissions
settings.label: Unsorted form submissions folder
settings.description: Where form-submission PDFs go when there is no case folder to file into. Leading spaces are load-bearing.

settings.value: /  Law Office/   Cases/  Unsorted Generated Documents
settings.label: Unsorted generated documents folder
settings.description: Where documents generated from a template go when there is no case folder to file into. Leading spaces are load-bearing.

settings.value: /  Law Office/   Cases/  Unsorted E-Signed Documents
settings.label: Unsorted e-signed documents folder
settings.description: Where signed documents land when no case folder can be found or created. Leading spaces are load-bearing.

settings.label: E-sign test mode
settings.description: 1 = envelopes are sent in the provider's test mode (free, watermarked, capped). 0 = live: each envelope consumes credits.

settings.label: Default reminder sequence
settings.description: Sequence enrolled for every e-sign send unless the contract template overrides it. Blank = no automatic reminders by default.

settings.label: Credit balance (estimate)
settings.description: Approximate credits remaining. There is no balance API: the app counts it down per live envelope, so re-enter it after buying credits. Blank disables credit tracking.

settings.label: Low-credit alert threshold
settings.description: Raise a staff task when the estimated balance falls below this. Only meaningful with a balance entered.

settings.label: Payment-failure drip cooldown (days)
settings.description: Do not re-enrol the same contact in the payment-failed drip within this many days of the last enrolment.

settings.label: Portal live
settings.description: Client-portal kill switch: 1 = up, 0 = down (logins refused, sessions rejected on the next request). Absent behaves as 1.

settings.label: Portal email from
settings.description: Sender of client-portal login-code emails. Must exist as a sending address, or portal login emails fail.

settings.label: Portal SMS monthly cap
settings.description: Maximum login-code texts per calendar month (UTC). At the cap no SMS is sent and one alert fires per month. Cost control, not a security control.

settings.label: Callback task assignee
settings.description: Staff member assigned the task a client-portal callback request creates. Must be a valid user or callback requests fail.

settings.label: Upload notification to
settings.description: Recipient of the email sent when a client uploads documents. Blank = upload emails off (the case log entry still writes).

settings.label: Portal logo URL
settings.description: Logo in the portal header on every page including login. Blank = the firm logo.

settings.label: Portal favicon URL
settings.description: Browser-tab icon for the portal. Blank = the effective portal logo.

settings.label: Portal logo link
settings.description: Where the portal header logo links: an http(s) URL or a single-/ site path. Blank = portal home on signed-in pages, not clickable on login.

settings.value: ["Search engine","Referral - Client","Referral - Attorney","Past Client","Radio","Television","Social Media","Direct Mail","Walk-in","A deliberately overlong lead source label that has to wrap","Other"]
settings.label: Lead sources
settings.description: Marketing lead-source options offered on the case Overview tab. Suggestions only — the field accepts free text.

settings.label: Event types (legacy list)
settings.description: The new-event dialog and the Events tab filter read this list; the event form falls back to it when the calendar-type registry is unreachable. Renaming or removing a type does not change existing events.

settings.label: Case types
settings.description: Case type → subtypes. Edited in Types & Subtypes, which checks usage and repoints pipeline templates.

settings.label: Default expiry (single-use)
settings.description: Expiry for a single-use CTA link minted without one. Duration like 30m, 12h, 3d, 2w. Max 365d.

settings.label: Default expiry (repeatable)
settings.description: Expiry for a repeatable CTA link minted without one. Duration like 12h, 30d, 26w. Max 365d.

settings.label: App URL
settings.description: Base URL of this app. A wrong value breaks OAuth callbacks and every generated link.

settings.label: Uploads bucket
settings.description: Cloud Storage bucket for file uploads (world-readable objects).

settings.label: Comms archive bucket
settings.description: PRIVATE bucket for call recordings, MMS and mail bytes — never the uploads bucket. Unset → the archive sweep stops.

settings.label: Force reload before
settings.description: Blank = off. Date / datetime / epoch ms: open tabs on builds older than this are force-reloaded. Self-expiring.

settings.label: Cloud Tasks accelerator
settings.description: 1 = due jobs also get a Cloud Tasks push so they fire within seconds. 0 = off; jobs ride the 60s cron (nothing is lost). Kill switch: set 0, NOT blank — blank falls through to the env var. Instances converge within 60s.

settings.label: Mail send daily budget
settings.description: {"gmail": n, "smtp": n}: hub sends per sending account per day, counted from the email log. Unset = the code defaults (1500 Gmail / 300 SMTP).

settings.label: Landing hosts
settings.description: Hostnames served as the public landing origin (pages, /f, /r, /api/ext only). First entry = canonical redirect target. Empty = off. A security boundary: SU console only.

settings.label: Landing redirects
settings.description: 1 = non-landing hosts redirect GET /p/*, /f/* and ext-mode render to the canonical landing host. 0 = instant revert. SU console only.

settings.label: Documents sync engine
settings.description: 1 = the Dropbox → documents sync runs. Anything else = off. Read uncached; turning it off mid-backfill is safe (the cursor waits).

settings.label: Court ingest live
settings.description: 1 = the court-email pipeline executes its actions. 0 = review-only.

settings.label: Trustee validation live
settings.description: 1 = validate_case_trustee writes the case and alerts staff. Anything else = dry run (no case writes; alerts IT).

settings.label: Min severity for email
settings.description: Alerts below this severity record to System Alerts but send no email.

settings.label: Alert cooldown (hours)
settings.description: A repeat of the same alert inside this window does not email again.

settings.label: Dropbox credential
settings.description: Connections credential the Dropbox integration authenticates with.

settings.label: E-sign credential
settings.description: Connections credential for the e-sign provider (OAuth2). Blank disables all sending.

settings.label: Google Calendar credential
settings.description: Connections credential for calendar sync and free/busy. Unset = the code's built-in default credential.

settings.label: Google Calendar id
settings.description: The firm calendar appointments sync to.

settings.label: Google Contacts credential
settings.description: Connections credential for the Google Contacts sync.

settings.label: Google Contacts excluded domains
settings.description: Comma-separated email domains never synced to Google Contacts. Unset = the code default (the firm's own domain).

settings.label: Alert sweep last ran
settings.description: Written by the alert sweep.

settings.label: Error sweep watermarks
settings.description: Per-source high-water marks of the error sweep.

settings.label: Job runner heartbeat
settings.description: Written on every /process-jobs tick.

settings.label: Documents sweep watermark
settings.description: Written by the documents sync.

settings.label: E-sign webhook last seen
settings.description: Written on every e-sign webhook delivery.

settings.label: E-sign low-credit latch
settings.description: 1 = the low-credit task is already raised for this dip; cleared when a send leaves the balance at or above the threshold.

settings.label: Portal SMS counter
settings.description: Month counter of portal login-code texts (ym, count, alerted_ym).

settings.label: Google Contacts group
settings.description: Contact group the sync creates on first use.

settings.label: Clio login code
settings.description: The latest Clio 2FA code, captured from an inbound text by a phone-ingest rule.

settings.label: Comms archive sweep
settings.description: 1 = the archive sweep copies call recordings into the private archive. Anything else = off. Turning it off is always safe; the cliff-guard alarm keeps running.

settings.label: Transcription
settings.description: off: no new submissions (jobs already sent finish). sample: only the evaluation items. on: every archived recording and voicemail. Restricted calls are never sent. Anything else = off.

settings.label: STT credential
settings.description: Credential the transcription sweep calls through. Missing → transcription stops (alerted).

settings.label: Transcribe minimum (s)
settings.description: Audio shorter than this is skipped as short. Not applied to voicemails or in sample mode.

settings.label: STT per-call cap (min)
settings.description: Longer audio is skipped as over cap; an SU releases one from the db console.

settings.label: AI monthly cap (cents)
settings.description: Month-to-date transcription + summary spend that stops new submissions; archiving never stops. Missing / not a number = 0 = nothing submitted.

settings.label: STT stereo mode
settings.description: How a 2-channel recording is transcribed: diarize (one mixed channel + speaker labels) or multichannel (one transcript per channel, billed per channel). Anything else = diarize.

settings.value: ["Example","Example Firm","Chapter 7","Chapter 13","341 meeting","trustee","automatic stay","proof of claim","reaffirmation agreement"]
settings.label: STT keyterms
settings.description: Words / phrases (≤ 6 words each) the transcriber is primed with. Empty = off; non-empty costs extra per audio hour.

settings.label: STT language detection
settings.description: 1 = the vendor detects the language. Anything else = English.

settings.label: Summaries
settings.description: off: no summaries. sample: only the evaluation items. on: every transcribed call and voicemail. Restricted calls are never sent. Anything else = off.

settings.label: Summary model
settings.description: Model id the summaries use; an id the sweep does not accept stops the summaries (alerted).

settings.label: Summary effort
settings.description: The model's thinking effort (billed as output). Anything else = the summaries stop (alerted).

settings.label: Summary minimum (s)
settings.description: A call with less audio than this is not summarised. Not applied to voicemails or in sample mode.

settings.label: STT max speakers
settings.description: 0–10: a hard cap on speaker labels for diarized transcripts. 0 = no cap. Anything else = transcription stops (alerted).

settings.value: The firm is Example Firm, a consumer bankruptcy law office. Many incoming calls are first answered by an AI receptionist that greets callers, takes messages and books appointments. Recorded greetings are announcements, not anyone's statement. The firm's name is often mis-transcribed — read near misses as Example.
settings.label: Summary firm context
settings.description: Facts about how the firm's phones sound, for the AI call summaries (the AI receptionist, recorded greetings, call screening, names the transcriber mishears). Staff names come from the users table. At most 2,000 characters — longer stops the summaries (alerted).
